# IETF RFC - Pass
#
# Sampled from relaton-data-rfcs (branch v2), plus the numeric boundaries of
# the published corpus. The RFC form is just "RFC <digits>", so a sample plus
# the boundaries covers it; the full 9,757-row check is
# spec/pubid/ietf/corpus_round_trip_spec.rb (opt-in via PUBID_IETF_CORPUS).
#
# The zero-padded rfc-index.xml spelling (RFC0001) is deliberately NOT here:
# it parses but renders back unpadded, and this file is byte-exact. It is
# pinned by spec/pubid/ietf/zero_padded_spec.rb.
